title: My First Coloring Book: Animals (Part 1)
developmental_focus: Fine-motor coloring practice (whole-hand/early tripod crayon grasp) paired with familiar animal vocabulary, pairing well with the fully-illustrated My First Animal Sounds book (same 2-3 age band) by giving the same familiar animals as coloring outlines instead of finished color art.
safety_notes: One animal per page, single simple black-line outline on white, no fine internal detail that would frustrate an early crayon grip.
All animals depicted in friendly, non-threatening poses (no roaring/aggressive poses), consistent with My First Animal Sounds.
Line art only, no pre-filled color -- coloring is the point of this book.
